in_hebrew.name: Isabea
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Mythology: Dedicated to Isis
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Isabea הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. In Greek mythology, Isabea is a name derived from Isis, the goddess of motherhood, fertility, and magic. It is believed to represent the embodiment of the divine feminine and the strength and wisdom of the goddess.

in_greek.name: Isabea
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Mythology: Dedicated to Isis

In Greek mythology, Isabea is a name derived from Isis, the goddess of motherhood, fertility, and magic.
